room_rent.note: Standard A/C room (single occupancy with attached washroom, excludes suite). Proportionate deduction applies if higher room taken.

icu.note: ICU expenses paid at actuals as per policy wording Section C1(b).

copayment.note: No mandatory co-pay in base plan. Voluntary co-pay of 5%/10%/15%/20% available as optional discount. If 'Cashless Discount' rider opted, 20% co-pay applies on reimbursement claims.

sub_limits.display: Cataract capped at 10% of SI, max ₹50,000/eye (inbuilt)
sub_limits.note: Inbuilt cataract sub-limit: 10% of SI per eye, max ₹50,000. Optional 'Procedure/Disease Sub-limit' cover adds caps on cardiac, joints, hernia, calculi, hysterectomy, spine, cancer, etc. in exchange for premium discount.

deductible.note: No deductible in base plan. Voluntary aggregate deductible of ₹10,000/₹20,000/₹30,000/₹40,000/₹50,000/₹1L/₹2L/₹3L available as optional discount.

initial_waiting.note: 30-day waiting period for illnesses; accidents exempt. Not applicable if continuously covered for more than 12 months.

ped_waiting.note: 36 months continuous coverage required. Reducible via portability/migration credit.

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24-month waiting for listed conditions including cataract, hernia, calculi, hysterectomy, organ transplant, etc. Accidents exempt.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered. No optional maternity add-on mentioned.

cumulative_bonus.note: Inbuilt CB: 10% of base SI per claim-free year, max 100%. Optional 'Super Cumulative Bonus' add-on offers up to 200% at 25%/yr or 50%/yr.

restoration.note: Sum Insured Reinstatement is an optional cover. Options: once per policy year or unlimited times per policy year. Available for subsequent hospitalisation after 2-day gap. Not available for organ donor or modern treatment claims.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 30 days prior to admission.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days after discharge.

day_care.note: Extensive indicative list in Annexure I; any procedure requiring <24 hrs due to technology also covered.

domiciliary.note: Covered up to SI if patient cannot be moved or no hospital room available; must exceed 3 days. Several conditions excluded (asthma, diabetes, hypertension, etc.).

ayush.note: AYUSH hospitalisation (min 24 hrs) covered up to In-patient SI. Comfort/leisure treatments excluded.

organ_donor.note: Donor harvesting expenses covered up to SI. Pre/post-hospitalisation for donor not covered. Restoration benefit not applicable.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered up to In-patient Hospitalisation SI for emergency transfer and inter-hospital transfer.

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, oral chemo, stereotactic radiosurgery, etc.) covered up to SI. CB and restoration not applicable for this cover.

consumables.note: Annexure II lists non-medical/consumable items as excluded. No optional consumables rider mentioned.

global_cover.note: Policy covers treatment within India only. No international cover option mentioned.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim can be contested except for fraud and permanent exclusions.

grace_period.note: 30 days for all modes except monthly premium which has 15-day grace period.

free_look.note: 30-day free-look at inception only; not applicable at renewal or porting.

portability.note: Portability as per IRDAI guidelines; apply at least 30 days before renewal.

notable_exclusions.display: No overseas treatment, no maternity, domiciliary excludes diabetes/hypertension/asthma, external congenital anomalies, growth hormone therapy

optional_riders.display: Sum Insured Reinstatement (once/unlimited), Super Cumulative Bonus, Disease Sub-limits (discount), Cashless Discount, Accidental Death Cover, No Claim Discount
